notes: Official Sony operating-instructions manual (projectorcentral-hosted copy of Sony doc, matches Sony's official datasheet table) confirms all terminals. No analog/HDMI audio connectors exist on this model (spec table has no audio row) — video and control only; audio must be handled externally. 3G-SDI input is available only via the optional BKM-PJ20 adaptor card, and that adaptor itself is listed as "Available for VPL-FHZ120L only" — so no SDI port on the FHZ90L. INPUT E (HDBaseT) and the separate LAN terminal are both RJ45 but serve different functions (HDBaseT carries video/RS-232/Ethernet over one cable; LAN terminal is a standard 10/100/1000BASE-T network port for control/HTML viewer). AC inlet is a standard rectangular IEC inlet for the detachable supplied power cord (IEC C13/C14 pattern based on current draw of 3.4-8.4A and the connector diagram); Sony's spec sheet does not name the IEC sub-type explicitly. No RS-232C/HDMI/DVI grade or version beyond HDCP support is specified (no HDMI 1.4/2.0 version stated); grade omitted per instructions since not explicitly stated as a version number. Desktop/tabletop or ceiling-mount unit, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted.

ports.name: INPUT A (RGB/YPbPr)
ports.note: 5x BNC female (R/Pr, G/Y, B/Pb, H, V) — RGB HD VD / YPbPr component or RGB computer signal

ports.name: INPUT B (RGB)
ports.note: Mini D-sub 15-pin female, RGB computer signal

ports.name: INPUT C (DVI-D)
ports.note: DVI-D 24-pin single link, DVI 1.0 compliant, HDCP support

ports.name: INPUT D (HDMI)
ports.note: HDMI 19-pin, digital RGB/YPbPr, HDCP support; version not stated

ports.name: INPUT E (HDBaseT)
ports.note: HDBaseT terminal; transmits HDMI video, RS-232C, and 100BASE-TX Ethernet over one CAT5e+ cable, max 100m

ports.name: OUTPUT (Monitor, RGB/YPbPr)
ports.note: Mini D-sub 15-pin female; loops through the signal from INPUT A or INPUT B

ports.name: USB
ports.note: USB Type-A; used for HTML viewer content and firmware updates only (no USB hub support)

ports.name: RS-232C
ports.note: D-Sub 9-pin male, RS-232C compatible control terminal

ports.name: AC IN
ports.note: Rectangular IEC power inlet for detachable supplied AC power cord; AC 100-240V, 3.4-8.4A, 50/60Hz
